name: Fighter
title: FIGHTER — Champion of the Battlefield
cardBlurb: What are your vocations, special talents, and favoured tactics?
flavour: Fighters rule many battlefields. They are expert warriors who combine martial prowess with personal stamina, training relentlessly to push body and mind to peak combat readiness.

options.name: Acrobatics
options.pitch: Keep your footing on treacherous ground and tumble out of harm's way.

options.name: Animal Handling
options.pitch: Calm nervous oxen, read wary horses, and ride with confidence.

options.name: Athletics
options.pitch: Force stuck doors, climb cliffs, and win contests of brute strength.

options.name: History
options.pitch: Recall old wars, fallen keeps, and what the ruins along the road once were.

options.name: Insight
options.pitch: Read faces and motives — know when a merchant, or a goblin, is lying.

options.name: Intimidation
options.pitch: Stare down threats and end some fights before they begin.

options.name: Perception
options.pitch: Spot hidden traps, ambushes, and secrets before they find you.

options.name: Survival
options.pitch: Track quarry, read the weather, and live off the wilds between towns.

fightingStyles.name: Defense
fightingStyles.pitch: +1 to Armour Class while wearing armour. You're tougher to hit.

fightingStyles.name: Dueling
fightingStyles.pitch: +2 damage with a one-handed weapon and no other weapon. Precision strikes.

fightingStyles.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fightingStyles.pitch: Reroll 1s and 2s on two-handed weapon damage. Go big or go home.

fightingStyles.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
fightingStyles.pitch: Add your ability modifier to off-hand damage. Twice the steel, twice the pain.

secondWind.pitch: Once per rest, catch your breath to recover 1d10 + 1 HP. A fighter's grit keeps them standing.
